adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff around line 453 in handleCancelBooking.ts, the code now iterates through bookingCalendarReference (an array of calendar references). However, inside the recurring event handling block (lines 430-450), the code still iterates through ALL user credentials that end with '_calendar' and for each credential, it loops through ALL updatedBookings and finds the FIRST calendar reference (using .find() not .filter()). This means: 1) Each credential processes all bookings' first calendar reference regardless of whether that reference belongs to that credential, 2) Secondary calendar references in each booking are never processed. The finding correctly identifies that this causes cross-calendar deletes (wrong credential deleting wrong calendar's event) and leaves secondary events behind (only first reference per booking is processed).
